memory_notes: Initial sandboxed process-tree samples had access errors and are excluded from memory comparisons.
Native query and cloned-index encoder-rebuild measurements had zero access errors.
Encoder rebuild reuses all metadata and OCR; it is not a complete fresh-index memory measurement.
RSS sampled every 20 ms, shared pages may count twice, short spikes may be missed.
limitations: Previously agent-reviewed known judgments; unknown competitors are not automatic negatives.
Small subset; do not compare its Recall@50 with the earlier full 2052-image diagnostic.
Sequential single-host measurements include startup, verification and OS cache effects.
No 8 GB hardware certification or native Windows/Linux inference evaluation.
Existing rerankers and training schema remain INT8-only.
